A LITTLE CIRCLE TO MAKE YOUR OWN

Easy Butterfly Mandala Coloring Page

A smiling butterfly spreads its wings inside a simple geometric circle. The broad wing sections make this an approachable page for children who like big coloring spaces.

  • Black & white line art
  • Large spaces for kids
  • Free personal & classroom use

Print your mandala

Print this mandala ↗

One drawing · A4 or Letter · Portrait
White margins and a smaller drawing help prevent cropped edges.

Inside this little mandala

The butterfly has matching wings divided into a few large curved sections. Circles decorate the wings and the surrounding ring. Rounded triangles form the outside pattern, creating a contrast with the softer wing shapes.

A coloring idea to try

Try coloring matching wing sections in the same color. For a different challenge, make each wing its own rainbow and compare the finished sides.

Make a little moment of it

Begin with the largest wing sections before moving to the smaller circles. Let your child decide whether to follow the symmetry or create a surprising pattern.

Use pencils or crayons for the smaller sections. Print on paper suited to your materials, and put a protective sheet underneath if using markers. Printing is free for home and classroom use; please link to this page when sharing the design online.
